title: Dolphin Kayak Tour in Virginia Beach Must know how to swim
blurb: Must know how to swim! Maximum single person weight 250lbs. GoKayak!DolphinToursVirginiaBeach! Enjoy the beauty of kayaking with Atlantic Bottlenose Dolphins on the peaceful waters of the Chesapeake Bay on this 2 hour guided kayak tour! We have seen stingrays, sea turtles, bald eagles, ospreys, dolphins and more! Our expert guides will optimize our chances of seeing the wildlife while giving you all the details of the ecosystem, history and the wildlife of the beautiful part of Virginia Beach!
